Fetch works from OpenAlex with caching

Source: R/api_helpers.R
fetch_openalex.Rd

Wraps openalexR::oa_fetch() with local file caching so repeated builds do not re-query the API. Each distinct set of arguments is stored as one RDS file in cache_dir.

fetch_openalex(
  ...,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  cache_days = 7,
  offline = identical(Sys.getenv("SCIENTOMETRICS_OFFLINE"), "1")
)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to openalexR::oa_fetch().

cache_dir

Directory for cached results. NULL (the default) uses the scientometricsInR.cache_dir option or, if that is unset, a folder in the session's temporary directory that is removed when R exits. Set the option or this argument to a persistent path to reuse results across sessions; the book uses "_freeze/openalex_cache".

cache_days

Non-negative days before cache expires; Inf never expires.

offline

Use an existing cache without any provider request, even if stale. Defaults to whether SCIENTOMETRICS_OFFLINE=1. Missing or unreadable caches fail explicitly; no synthetic/provider substitute is returned.

Value

A tibble of OpenAlex records as returned by openalexR::oa_fetch().

Examples

# Offline mode never contacts OpenAlex and fails when no cache exists.
cache <- file.path(tempdir(), "openalex-example")
res <- try(fetch_openalex(
  entity = "works", search = "scientometrics",
  cache_dir = cache, offline = TRUE
), silent = TRUE)
inherits(res, "try-error")
#> [1] TRUE
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# A live request needs internet access; results are cached in `cache`.
works <- fetch_openalex(
  entity = "works", search = "scientometrics",
  options = list(sample = 5, seed = 1), cache_dir = cache
)
unlink(cache, recursive = TRUE)
}
